_comment: Credit-rating-agency rationale docs per PRIVATE vendor — the FREE source for private financials (no API key, no Firecrawl). Discovered via web search; CI only RE-FETCHES these stored URLs (agency on-site search is WAF-blocked, so re-discovery is manual/periodic). Vendors with no doc are honestly 'unrated'. CRISIL = HTML (needs browser UA), others = PDF. ICRA uses ?Id= (capital I).

docs.note: Most recent cooperating rationale; CARE moved an earlier rating to Issuer-Not-Cooperating (Sep 2024).

unrated._note: Searched across CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/Acuité/Infomerics — no rated bank facilities found under the vendor's own legal name (MNC subsidiaries & small private firms are often unrated). Shown honestly as 'financials not public'.
